tagline: Save points for code, for when git is overkill.
summary: A checkpoint tool for projects where full version control is more ceremony than the work deserves — experiments, tutorials and quick prototypes. A VS Code extension that snapshots the text of a workspace folder and writes it back on demand, so a risky change can be walked back without a branching model.
highlights: Aimed at the cases git is genuinely too heavy for: tutorials, throwaway experiments and rapid prototypes.
Restoring writes every captured file back over the working copy — an overlay rather than a rollback, so files added since the save point survive it.
Save points live in a plain JSON file under the folder's .vscode directory, which the extension adds to .gitignore so they stay out of the repository's history.
